title: Hi-Lo
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: premium illustrated casino catalogue title card.
Primary request: Create ONE original polished Hi-Lo title card, wide 2:1 landscape (1536x768 composition), opaque.
Scene/backdrop: rich emerald felt fading to dark forest green, restrained champagne-gold line accents and subtle table edge. Sophisticated classic casino mood.
Subject: ONE large warm-ivory Ace of Spades playing card standing at a slight elegant tilt, accompanied by two sculptural gold arrow forms, one sweeping upward and one downward. Arrows are free-standing illustration motifs with gentle curves, never inside buttons or panels. Ace face has clean black A/spade indices top-left and rotated lower-right and ONE large central black spade, rounded ivory edges. Subtle card deck beneath it. No other face-up cards. A couple of small red-and-cream striped chips beside the deck.
Style/medium: polished professionally painted game key art, tangible materials, soft controlled highlights and depth, clean silhouettes. Premium collection feel, not photoreal money, not icons or clipart.
Composition/framing: wide 2:1. Large title and separate card/arrow vignette form a balanced central composition. ALL title letters, ace and arrow heads within central 80% width and central 70% height; generous margins and quiet felt behind the title. Title must dominate and be readable at 240px thumbnail width.
Text (verbatim): "Hi-Lo". Exact spelling and hyphen, capital H and L, once only, large cream-gold serif type with understated beveled gold edge.
Constraints: no extra words or numbers outside authentic A indices, no jokers or court cards, no portraits, no interface/buttons/paytable, no payouts/slogans, no coins or piles of money, no logos, no watermark, no excessive light rays or sparks. One image only.

visualCheck.fullSize: Inspected master and final 768x384 WebP. Exact Hi-Lo spelling/hyphen, clear ace, free-standing up/down arrows, emerald felt, restrained red chips. Screenshot used only for palette, not retired card styling. No fake UI or extra copy. Title fully inside central safe region; card remains legible under cropping.
visualCheck.thumbnail: Inspected 240x120: large title, ace and both arrow directions read clearly.
visualCheck.compression: 40,592 bytes; quality 84; below 120 KB ideal target.
